name: Hefei Xinqiao International Airport
before:
Anhui's main airport, in Shushan District 31.8 km from central Hefei. It handled about 12.6 million passengers in 2025 across 97,281 movements.

It is a relatively new airport. Construction began in December 2008 at a cost of 3.728 billion yuan and it opened on 30 May 2013, replacing Hefei Luogang. The first phase gave it a single 3,400 metre runway and a terminal built for 11 million passengers a year, a figure it has already passed. A second phase is planned to take the airport to 42 million passengers by 2040.

Long haul has been tried and has not stuck. Condor began flying to Frankfurt in December 2022 but dropped the route after a few months.
after:
The airport for Hefei, the capital of Anhui province, 31.8 km from the city centre in a straight line. It handled about 12.6 million passengers in 2025 across 97,281 aircraft movements.

It is a relatively new airport. It opened on 30 May 2013, replacing Hefei Luogang. Its single runway is 3,400 metres long, and the first phase was built for 11 million passengers a year, a figure it has already passed.
